title: Independent-Host Multi-Node Running-Workload End-to-End Replication
action: zero-grace Pod delete after an accepting gate; aborting gates send no response action
primary_safety_endpoints: commit-time platform authorization recheck via Kubernetes SelfSubjectAccessReview
actual effect only after accepting gate
decision-to-gate for aborts and conservative decision-to-observed-effect upper-bound timing for successful executions
notes: Replication of E34 on a 3-node kind topology (1 control-plane, 2 workers) on the independent external host. The workload is pinned to a worker labeled flashir-role=e36-worker. LANL and human construct validation are out of scope.
authorization_recheck: Kubernetes SelfSubjectAccessReview for verb=delete, resource=pods, namespace=<experiment namespace>, evaluated before the object refresh/gate on each client-guard trial; native-precondition trials also record the same authorization recheck.
